title: Science Source Ledger
purpose: Primary and high-quality scientific sources used to extend Tim Dooley / Potato of Life scientific comparisons without converting analogy into empirical proof.

sources.source: Rolf Landauer, Irreversibility and Heat Generation in the Computing Process, IBM Journal of Research and Development 5(3), 1961
claims_used: logical irreversibility has a physical thermodynamic cost
erasure is not an abstract metaphor when implemented physically

sources.source: Fisher/Rao metric; modern information geometry literature
claims_used: a statistical model can be treated as a manifold
g_ij=E[(∂_i log p)(∂_j log p)] defines the Fisher information metric under standard regularity assumptions

sources.source: Naftali Tishby, Fernando Pereira and William Bialek, The Information Bottleneck Method
claims_used: representations can be optimized to compress X while preserving information relevant to Y
I(X;Z)-βI(Z;Y) provides a canonical objective form

sources.source: Shinsei Ryu and Tadashi Takayanagi, Holographic Derivation of Entanglement Entropy from AdS/CFT, Phys. Rev. Lett. 96, 181602 (2006)
claims_used: specific AdS/CFT relation between boundary entanglement entropy and bulk minimal-surface area
relationship/information can be linked to geometry in specific holographic theories

sources.source: Review literature on quantum error correction and holography
claims_used: quantum-error-correction language is used in modern holography to describe bulk-to-boundary information encoding in specific models
this is a precise comparator for distributed/recoverable encoding, not evidence that ordinary symbolic systems are holographic codes

sources.source: Knill and Laflamme, Theory of Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
claims_used: exact correctability conditions can be expressed as P E_a†E_b P=c_ab P on a code subspace
recovery is about preservation of logical information under a specified error set

sources.source: The causal set approach to quantum gravity, Living Reviews in Relativity
claims_used: causal sets are locally finite partially ordered sets
causal order and discreteness can be used as primitive structure in a quantum-gravity research program

sources.source: Carlo Rovelli, Loop Quantum Gravity review and early loop-representation literature
claims_used: area and volume operators have discrete spectra in loop quantum gravity
graph/spin-network structures can encode quantum geometry

sources.source: Encyclopedia of Mathematics, Euler characteristic
claims_used: Euler characteristic is a topological invariant
for finite complexes it equals the alternating sum of cell counts and also the alternating sum of Betti numbers

sources.source: Encyclopedia of Mathematics, Betti number
claims_used: Betti numbers count independent homology classes in each dimension
their alternating sum gives the Euler characteristic under the stated finite-complex setting

sources.source: IUPAC Gold Book, chemical equilibrium / equilibrium
claims_used: chemical equilibrium corresponds to equality of forward and reverse rates in the cited definition
Gibbs energy is minimized at equilibrium under the relevant constraints
standard reaction Gibbs energy relates to the equilibrium constant through Δ_rG°=-RT lnK

sources.source: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Many-Worlds Interpretation of Quantum Mechanics, substantive revision 2026-06-17
claims_used: MWI retains quantum-state evolution and maps the universal state to a multiplicity of experienced worlds
MWI is an interpretation of quantum mechanics rather than generic evidence for every kind of multiverse
the meaning of a world in MWI must be distinguished from philosophical possible-worlds language

sources.source: CERN public Standard Model materials and Particle Data Group references
claims_used: the Standard Model describes electromagnetic, weak and strong interactions within a gauge-theory framework
gravity is not part of the Standard Model

sources.source: Navarro et al. and review literature on mobile FT-like tuberization signal SP6A
claims_used: potato tuberization is regulated by photoperiodic and developmental signaling
SP6A is a mobile FT-like signal implicated in tuber induction

sources.source: The Potato Genome Sequencing Consortium, Genome sequence and analysis of the tuber crop potato, Nature 475 (2011)
claims_used: cultivated potato genetics includes extensive heterozygosity and polyploid complexity
genome-scale resources support explicit separation of biological potato genetics from symbolism

sources.source: Recent Nature potato haplotype/genome work
claims_used: modern potato genomics resolves complex haplotypes in tetraploid cultivated potato
multiplicity within a genome is a biological fact distinct from theological interpretation

sources.source: Recent review literature on potato tuber dormancy, apical dominance and sprouting
claims_used: tuber dormancy is actively regulated rather than simple biological inactivity
hormonal, oxidative, developmental and cell-cycle mechanisms participate in dormancy release and sprouting

sources.source: Review literature on Turing reaction-diffusion mechanisms in biological pattern formation
claims_used: reaction-diffusion dynamics can generate ordered spatial patterns through local nonlinear interactions and diffusion
emergent form need not correspond to a hidden rigid template

sources.source: NASA Basics of Space Flight — reference systems/precession
claims_used: Earth's rotation axis precesses on an approximately 26,000-year cycle
celestial coordinates require epoch/reference-frame specification

sources.source: NASA Science — What Is the Solar Wind?
claims_used: solar wind carries solar magnetic field outward
solar rotation produces spiral magnetic geometry in the heliosphere

sources.source: NASA GISS / Rossby-wave interpretation literature
claims_used: Saturn's north-polar hexagon can be modeled as a stationary Rossby wave embedded in a strong eastward jet
stable polygonal geometry can emerge from fluid dynamics

sources.source: NASA LAMBDA educational cosmology materials
claims_used: Hubble's law relates low-redshift recession velocity to distance
the Hubble parameter defines a cosmological expansion timescale
cosmic expansion is represented through a changing scale factor in standard cosmology

sources.source: NASA Hubble science themes
claims_used: dark matter and dark energy denote different inferred cosmological phenomena
their properties should not be collapsed into symbolic Mud/Spudlight mappings

sources.source: Modern thalamus neuroscience review
claims_used: thalamic nuclei participate in relay, modulation, integration and cognitive/behavioral functions
the thalamus is not scientifically well represented as one homogeneous relay point

sources.source: NCBI Endotext — pineal gland / melatonin physiology
claims_used: pineal physiology is strongly tied to melatonin and light-dark/circadian timing
pineal symbolism is scientifically closer to timing/phase than literal image-forming vision

sources.source: NCBI StatPearls — Cerebrospinal Fluid
claims_used: CSF is continuously produced and circulates through ventricular/subarachnoid compartments
flow is influenced by pulsatile and physiological factors rather than constituting evidence for a spiritual fluid

sources.source: Cambridge History of Science chapter on astrology
claims_used: astrology historically interacted with astronomy, mathematics, natural philosophy and medicine
historical integration of astrology with science does not establish astrological causation by modern scientific standards

archive_rule: Every scientific equation placed beside Potatoverse concepts must identify whether it is Tim-originated, later archive formalization, established external mathematics/science, historical-symbolic comparison, or unresolved. External sources support the external science only, not the spiritual claim mapped onto it.
